title: RefinementList improvement: "show XX more"
body:
Below the list of X refinements, it would be cool to have a "Show Y more" toggling hidden values.

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/29529/10883225/c7c0fbb6-8170-11e5-9ae0-27b54987bc1e.png)

## API (proposal/bobylito)

### Need

Let the user display more choices in a single `refinementList` widget. Those will be actually fetched each time but they are hidden. We would need the max number of items to display when not hidden, and also the max number of items to fetch at each search result to avoid loading too much items. We also need two templates for the 'show more' link/button so that we have the display for each of its state.

### Proposal

Here are the following new options for the `refinementList` widget :

* options.templates.showmore-active : template used when we displayed more facets values
* options.templates.showmore-inactive : template used when the more facets are hidden
* options.showmore
* options.showmore.maxDefaultDisplayItems : number of items displayed when the state is inactive
* options.showmore.maxFetchedFacetValues : the number of facet values fetched at each request

### Behaviour specifics

This feature relies on `maxValuesPerFacet` which is common to all the facets retrieved. If two `refinementList` use showmore, the value used in configuration should be the max() of the two.
